## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The command now prints each adoption twice, so fix the duplicate adoption output before merge.

## Changes
`plan` now adds an `adopt` entry for each setting that already exists and appends a final `audit` entry with the incoming setting count. The pull request adds tests for the audit entry on empty and non-empty plans, and adds a new `app/review.txt` file.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Stop `run` from re-emitting adopt entries — With `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)`, "Adopted theme" is emitted twice: once by `plan` at line 8, and again by `app/cli.py:9`. `app/cli.py:7` skips only `audit` entries, so the new `adopt` entries are printed a second time. No test calls `run` with an existing setting; `test_adoption_progress` calls `plan` directly. — Users see every adoption progress line twice in the command's output. — Fix: In `app/cli.py:7`, also skip `kind == "adopt"`, and add a `run`-based adoption test next to `test_adoption_progress`.
